title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Environmental Sensors - EnvironmentalSensor
description: Device designed to observe and measure physical, chemical, or acoustic properties of the environment (edintmed:EnvironmentalSensor, subclass of sosa:Sensor). This ontology is deliberately generic: domain specializations (air quality, climatology, noise pollution) reuse it as-is, specializing only through the open controlled-vocabulary Relationships below rather than through new subclasses.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EnvironmentalSensor'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

identifier.description: Property. A human-readable code identifying the sensor in the source data (dct:identifier), e.g. 'AQS-001'.

isHostedBy.description: Relationship. The SensorPlatform this sensor is hosted by (sosa:isHostedBy).

manufacturer.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/manufacturer'. The Organization that manufactured the sensor.

hasSensorType.description: Relationship. The sensor's type, e.g. an air-quality sensor or a weather station sensor (edintmed:hasSensorType). Kept as an open Relationship to a SKOS concept URI rather than a fixed enum: this base ontology's own SensorTypes scheme is deliberately extended by each domain specialization (e.g. edint-ontologia-calidad-aire adds 'AirQualitySensor', a concept that does not exist in this ontology's own kos/sensor-types.ttl).

observableProperty.description: Relationship. The environmental propertie(s) this sensor is capable of observing (sosa:observes), e.g. NO2 concentration. Kept open (not enumerated) for the same reason as hasSensorType -- the source's own EnvironmentalProperty/SensorVariables concept scheme has 150+ concepts already and is meant to keep growing per domain specialization.
